Welcome to CarrerNaviq

CarrerNaviq helps you organize your job search across employers, recruiters, jobs, learning, interview support, and AI-assisted applications.

Employer Directory

Find companies, LinkedIn pages, and career portals. Save companies to My List and help improve links over time.

Recruiter Directory

Browse recruiters by Java, Data, DevOps, Validation, or Multi-Role. Star useful recruiters for quick follow-up.

Latest Posted Jobs

Open the job tab and double-click a technology category to refresh recent jobs from connected job sources.

AI Auto Apply

Use your AI profile, resumes, saved answers, and blockers to prepare applications with approval before submission.

Study Materials

Keep learning documents organized by technology so users can study step by step.

Interview Support

Store interview support contacts and details for quick access when users need help.

Notifications

Important app updates will appear here.
